explanation: f'(x)=9x^8 is positive for every x≠0. At the only stationary point, x=0, the derivative stays positive on both sides, so there is no local extremum. The function is strictly increasing and has no local extrema.

answers.correct_value: The function $f(x)$ has no local extrema
answers.wrong_value: There is a local minimum at $x=0$
